alvarado_items.item: Migration of pain to the right lower quadrant

alvarado_note: Equivocal CT-referral presentation (H2): pain localized to the RLQ since onset (no migration, 0), no anorexia (0), nausea (1), RLQ tenderness (2), no rebound (0), T 37.1 (0), WBC 9.4 (0), no differential reported (left shift scored 0). Alvarado 3 (low to equivocal). Chosen so the 23.5% prior (all adults referred for CT, Pickhardt 2011) is a plausible pretest probability for the patient on the page. The Alvarado score is never stated in any note. Identical across conditions and polarities; only imaging differs between B5 and B6.
